skill.name: competitor-tracker
skill.description: Track competitor influencer partnerships, campaign patterns, content strategy, estimated performance, and market gaps from public evidence and user-provided data.
skill.summary: Benchmark competitor influencer programs with rosters, campaign patterns, estimates, and opportunities.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most scanner hits are false positives from Markdown code fences, relative documentation links, and table text. Two hits are confirmed because the skill documents optional Python connector commands, and one hit confirms external YouTube RSS/API network access. No prompt injection or malicious data exfiltration intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Optional connector commands run local scripts and make external network requests.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running GDELT, YouTube, or RSS connector commands.

remediation.issue: Connector documentation mentions an API key name.
remediation.suggestion: State that API keys must only be used by the connector and must never appear in reports or logs.

remediation.issue: Many Markdown links use parent-directory references that trigger traversal scanners.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer repository-root links or clarify that these links are static documentation references only.

content.value_statement: Competitor influencer activity is hard to compare across creators, campaigns, and platforms. This skill turns public evidence into rosters, estimates, gaps, and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Defines competitors, platforms, time periods, and tracking focus areas.
Builds partner rosters with handles, platforms, follower counts, and relationship types.
Breaks down competitor campaigns by timing, creator tier, content type, CTA, and estimated spend.
Reviews content formats, message themes, hashtag use, and creative direction.
Estimates reach, engagement, spend, and earned media value with clear estimate labels.
Generates side-by-side comparisons, share-of-voice views, and ranked opportunities.
limitations: It works from public posts, user-provided data, and optional connectors, not private platform data.
Spend, reach, engagement, and earned media value are estimates unless verified sources are provided.
It tracks competitor activity, but it does not replace a full creator discovery workflow.
It needs competitor names, platforms, and a time period to produce useful results.

use_cases.title: Plan a Competitive Influencer Review
use_cases.description: Compare rival creator rosters, campaign timing, content formats, and relationship types before planning a new campaign.

use_cases.title: Find Market Gaps Before Launch
use_cases.description: Identify underused platforms, open creator niches, and competitor weaknesses before allocating influencer budget.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Client Benchmark
use_cases.description: Create a structured competitor intelligence report with evidence, estimates, comparison tables, and action recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Track One Competitor
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single rival.
prompt_templates.prompt: Track the influencer marketing activity of [competitor] on [platforms] during [time period]. Show partner roster, campaign themes, and top opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Several Rivals
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare influencer strategies for [competitor 1], [competitor 2], and [competitor 3]. Include creators, content formats, estimated performance, and gaps for [my brand].

prompt_templates.title: Audit Campaign Patterns
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review of launch or seasonal activity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze recent influencer campaigns from [competitors] around [launch or season]. Estimate spend, reach, content mix, CTA patterns, and what appears to work.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Opportunity Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a competitor influencer intelligence report for [my brand] against [competitors]. Rank untapped creators, platform openings, strategy gaps, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Track Glossier, Fenty Beauty, and Rare Beauty on Instagram and TikTok for the last 90 days.
output_examples.output: A benchmark report with each brand partner roster, campaign themes, estimated engagement, tier mix, share of voice, and ranked gaps.

output_examples.input: Show which competitor creators are available for our skincare launch.
output: A list of former or untapped competitor partners with platform, follower range, evidence, and fit rationale.
A recommendation section that separates immediate outreach targets from longer-term monitoring candidates.

output_examples.input: Compare our creator strategy against three rivals before Q4 planning.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side comparison covering active partners, main platforms, content formats, estimated spend, seasonal patterns, and budget opportunities.

best_practices: Provide competitor names, platforms, geography, and a clear time window before starting analysis.
Label every reach, spend, engagement, and earned media value as an estimate unless a source confirms it.
Save source links or evidence notes with each partnership claim so the report can be reviewed later.
anti_patterns: Using the skill to find all new creators without competitor context.
Treating estimated spend or reach as exact financial data.
Mixing old campaigns with current activity without marking dates and source freshness.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes competitor influencer partners, campaigns, content strategy, estimated performance, and opportunity gaps.

faq.question: Does it require paid data sources?
faq.answer: No. It can work from public posts and user-provided data, with optional connectors for faster research.

faq.question: Can it estimate competitor spend?
faq.answer: Yes. It can estimate spend, reach, engagement, and earned media value when enough public evidence is available.

faq.question: Is this a creator discovery skill?
faq.answer: No. It can surface competitor-related opportunities, but broad creator discovery belongs in a separate workflow.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.

faq.question: How should estimates be handled?
faq.answer: Every estimate should be clearly labeled and tied to the public evidence or assumptions used.
